notes.title: New Art Coming to Squid Grid!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Squids,
[/h3]
We would like to welcome our new artist [url=https://www.dangartman.com/]Dan Gartman[/url] to the Squid Grid Team! You can find his work in the games [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1075200/TOHU/]TOHU[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1114260/Under_What/]Under What?[/url]. 

Dan is hard at work to completely transform the art with hand-drawn animations in an immersive Steampunk world. 

[h3]Take a look at the progress:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43962793/ece14ce66289f70a77278b5cec90998c7e46a1e5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43962793/4ee28d8e199d9a83f123c950db4b8d516a2f9256.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43962793/20e15de3370d5d517c734231079f3285b4c959a8.png[/img]

[h3]Stay tuned for more:[/h3]
Please join our [url=https://discord.gg/7XM53jT7Au]Discord[/url] for more frequent updates and play-testing opportunities. 

Thank you for your support,

-The Squid Grid Team
